title: Count Max Bitwise-OR Subsets

monster.name: Saturation Fiend
monster.title: Accumulator of All-1 Bit Fields
monster.defeatQuote: Number of non-empty subsets achieving the theoretical maximum bitwise OR!

description: Given an integer array `nums`, find the maximum possible bitwise OR of a subset of `nums` and return the number of different non-empty subsets with the maximum bitwise OR.
solutionCode:
def countMaxOrSubsets(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    max_or = 0
    for x in nums: max_or |= x
    ans = [0]
    def backtrack(idx, curr_or):
        if idx == len(nums):
            if curr_or == max_or: ans[0] += 1
            return
        backtrack(idx + 1, curr_or | nums[idx])
        backtrack(idx + 1, curr_or)
    backtrack(0, 0)
    return ans[0]
hints: Max possible OR is the bitwise OR of all elements. Backtrack over 2^n subsets counting matches.
